description: One step of a playbook. Steps run in order; a Condition or Approval step can send the run somewhere else.

fields.description: One of the registered Sales AI tools. Tool steps go through the same approval policy as the chat agent.
fields.label: Tool

fields.description: A JSON object of arguments. Text values may use {{ }} to refer to earlier steps, {{ doc }} and {{ now }}.
fields.label: Arguments

fields.description: What to ask the model. An AI step reads and judges; it cannot call tools or change anything.
fields.label: Prompt

fields.description: JSON asks the model for a JSON object, so later steps can use individual values. Unparseable output fails the step.
fields.label: Output Format

fields.description: A Python expression. Earlier steps are available by key.

fields.description: The run is put down and picked up again when the time is up. Checked every five minutes.
fields.label: Unit

fields.description: What to ask the person the playbook runs as. The run waits until they answer.
fields.label: Question

fields.description: A Python expression that gives a list, e.g. find['records'].

fields.description: The name each element takes inside the loop.
fields.label: As

fields.description: The key of the last step inside the loop. Everything from here to there repeats.

fields.description: What this run should say it did, as a template. Shown on the run and in the notification.
